items.stem: What does an open table format such as Delta Lake or Iceberg add on top of Parquet files in object storage?

options.text: A metadata layer providing ACID transactions, schema evolution and time travel
options.rationale: Correct: the table format tracks files and snapshots to give database-like guarantees over object storage.

options.text: A faster columnar compression than Parquet
options.rationale: Compression is a property of the file format; the table format adds transactional metadata.

options.text: A replacement for all SQL query engines
options.rationale: Table formats are read by engines; they do not replace them.
They are designed for distributed object storage, not single nodes.

items.explanation: Correct: the table format tracks files and snapshots to give database-like guarantees over object storage.

items.stem: Which statements about the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Bronze holds raw ingested data, silver holds cleaned/conformed data
options.rationale: Correct: data is progressively refined from bronze to silver.

options.text: Gold tables are curated for business consumption and reporting
options.rationale: Correct: gold is the aggregated, business-ready layer.

options.text: Business dashboards should read directly from the bronze layer
options.rationale: Dashboards should read curated gold, not raw bronze.

options.text: Each layer must use a different storage system
options.rationale: The layers are logical and typically share the same lakehouse storage.

items.explanation: Correct: data is progressively refined from bronze to silver.; Correct: gold is the aggregated, business-ready layer.

items.stem: Why is partitioning a lakehouse table on a very high-cardinality column usually a mistake?

options.text: It produces a huge number of tiny files that slow queries and metadata handling
options.rationale: Correct: excessive partitions fragment data into small files and bloat metadata.
ACID is provided by the table format regardless of partitioning.

options.text: It prevents the use of Parquet
options.rationale: Partitioning does not change the underlying file format.

items.explanation: Correct: excessive partitions fragment data into small files and bloat metadata.
